# Northstar Ops — GeoIntelligence & Service Operations Hub

> Parameterized GeoIntelligence platform and Atlassian Forge / Rovo MCP hub for local service operations. Features a live OpenStreetMap case study (Radom, Poland, 10–100 km radius) and supports dynamic multi-city, multi-industry, and multi-currency (PLN/USD) market intelligence.

## Core Capabilities

- Dynamic GIS service radius visualization (10–100 km)
- Localized competitor price benchmarking and customer review pain-point analysis
- Zone-based travel fee and service quote calculation
- Automated Atlassian Confluence strategy drafting and Jira marketing Epic generation

## MCP Server & Agent Endpoints

- Discovery & JSON Schemas (`GET`): `/api/mcp`
- MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 Execution (`POST`): `/api/mcp`
  - Supported JSON-RPC methods: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`

## Available MCP Tools

- `analyzeCompetitors({ center: string, radiusKm: number })`
  - Analyzes competitor price positioning, towns covered inside `radiusKm` (10–100), and customer review pain points.
- `calculateServiceFee({ town: string, orderValue: number })`
  - Computes zone travel fee and total customer quote in PLN for a supported town.
- `generateLocalizedCampaign({ season: string, targetTowns: string[], locale?: "en" | "pl" })`
  - Builds a localized campaign brief addressing regional pain points.
- `exportStrategyToConfluence({ center: string, radiusKm: number, season: string, locale?: "en" | "pl" })`
  - Generates a structured Confluence strategy page payload synced with active radius metrics.
- `createJiraMarketingEpics({ center: string, radiusKm: number, locale?: "en" | "pl" })`
  - Produces a Jira marketing Epic (`OPS-101`) with localized town subtasks for the active coverage zone.

## Atlassian Forge Integration

- Manifest location: `src/manifest.yml`
- Modules: `confluence:globalPage`, `jira:projectPage`, `rovo:agent`, `rovo:action`, `function`
- Required scopes: `read:confluence-content.all`, `write:confluence-content`, `read:jira-work`, `write:jira-work`, `read:rovo:chat`

## Public Pages

- Interactive Dashboard: `/`
- Privacy Policy: `/privacy`
- Terms of Service: `/terms`
